title: wkdoctor
desc: wkdoctor: standalone PS health-check tool. NOT a wkappbot subcommand (too frequently updated to bundle). Runs plugins in wkappbot-sdk/bin/wkappbot.hq/doctor/*.ps1 via admin Eye.
steps: wkdoctor -- full health check (17+ ok = healthy)
wkdoctor -DefenderFix -- add exclusions, self-elevates via admin Eye

requirements.expect: Already optimized or Defender exclusions added

author: claude
